dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: #How are we feeling, {NICKNAME}? Let's continue guiding the Ashas as they collect the paint balls!

choices.text: Let's do our best!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Alright! It's always so exciting to be on an adventure with you!

choices.text: Any more good news?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Well, let me think...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: ..Because I was having such great luck in Natlan, I was able to explore things I hadn't dared to delve into before...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: For example, making myself a perfectly suited set of adventure gear! Wristguards, knee pads, leg wraps, and insoles — all included!

choices.text: Those are some rather unexpected items...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: #That's something you should also pay more attention to, {NICKNAME}. Protecting your joints and feet from injury is really important when you're on an adventure.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Climbing with a load puts your knees under constant stress. So when you're moving through rugged terrain, you've got to stay sure-footed — one wrong step, and you could easily twist an ankle.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: On longer hikes, your feet might give out before your legs do. You've got to guard against fatigue, or you might end up hurting yourself without even realizing it.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: That's when gear that cushions impact and protects you really comes in handy.

choices.text: You do have a point there.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: In the long run, you can never have too much handy gear!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: You might also be interested in some tips other adventurers have gathered through years of trial and error...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: For example, you can chop up plants like the Calla Lily and Saurian Claw Succulent, crush them into a flour, and cook the mixture with Unmoving Essential Oil for a couple of days.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Then, pour everything into a mold and let it cool next to the Mist Flower overnight. After that, just trim it lightly and shave off any uneven parts...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: And voilà, you've got protective gear that's even more shock-absorbing than the Prancing Mushrooms of Sumeru! They say with it on, you could climb the Great Volcano of Tollan twice in a day and your soles and joints would still be fine!

choices.text: That sounds like a pretty straightforward process to me.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: You know, if I were anywhere else, I'd probably find myself stuck at the cooking part...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Either something unknown gets mixed into the pot and the whole thing spoils halfway through, or the entire pot explodes and sends fragments flying everywhere...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: If I went shopping for something similar, I'd either end up with gear that doesn't fit me or something of poor quality.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Not that the seller is deliberately trying to sell me something inferior — rather, they might not even be aware of the quality issues themselves... I'd just have to chalk it up to bad luck in either case.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: That's why I've never had good protective gear before. While it's not exactly mission-critical, but it definitely affects how your adventure goes.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: So, I decided to get exactly what I need to finally make gear I'd be satisfied with during this trip to the resort...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: This feels so wonderful... So this is what it feels like to run with good insoles and knee pads that fit just right!

choices.text: Although I could probably climb the volcano a few times even without it...
I haven't really thought about that before.
But why these?
Are there any of your other friends around here?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Well, if you mean the adventurer friends I've met before, they're all satisfied and have gone back home with my dads.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: The only ones left in Natlan are a few tourists from Mondstadt who rode in with us.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: But there was... I think a wrestler with horns on her head? She came up to me and asked if I'd seen a girl wearing a hat...

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: I heard that wrestler is some big-shot warrior from the Collective of Plenty who did pretty well at the Dragonspine International Cross Country Challenge.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Maybe quite a few of those Mondstadters have made friends with the people of Natlan while we weren't looking...?

choices.text: I'll come back later.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Alright, we'll be waiting for you!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Minnie, Minnie... Look at what Asha painted over there. Doesn't it look like a Fonta bottle got knocked over... with juice splashed all over a mushroom pizza?

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: You're right! It sure looks like it...

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: Now I want to eat it.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Me too... But isn't it a bit strange to mix the flavor of Bulle Fruit with mushroom?

choices.text: Should we give it a try?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Huh? Am I... hallucinating from too many mushrooms...?

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: #Nope. It's really {NICKNAME}! What a surprise to see you here at the resort!

choices.text: Your name was... Minnie, right?

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Oh, you remember me? Nice... I feel really encouraged again...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: That's right! She's our lead artist at The Legion of Soulblazers who's now working on a side story For The Soulblazer Saga.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Minnie's done something really amazing this time, she came all the way to Natlan by herself, riding in on the adventurers' caravan!

choices.text: That really is a long way to come.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: #It's okay now, and it's all thanks to you, {NICKNAME}, Varesa, and Xilonen. You convinced my parents before, so they're not as strict anymore.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: After the cross-country challenge, I finally had the chance to draw some public service posters for the Church of Favonius, as well as illustrations for a few publications...

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Later on, Varesa sent a story I wrote inspired by The Soulblazer Saga to Yae Publishing House, and it was noticed by Ms. Asagiri, the famous illustrator.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: What incredible luck! Ms. Asagiri liked my work so much, she even wrote a letter to mom and dad.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Now, my parents understand that illustration can be a serious career and is very much worth my time.

choices.text: Sounds like things are going well for you.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: If you ask me, Minnie, you should believe in yourself more. Your skills have nothing to do with luck. They're the result of your hard work every day.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: It's like... how I can wrestle pretty well these days thanks to my training with Coach Iansan.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Ms. Asagiri has also worked on illustrations and comics for many "The Soulblazers" titles, and she directly recommended Minnie to Editor Moriko, who is known for her extremely high standards...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: And it so happened that they had been looking for an artist for the comic adaptation of a side story in The Soulblazer Saga for quite some time...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: They had Minnie take a written test, on which she scored over 90 points and even broke the recruitment record!

choices.text: That's incredible!

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: T—thank you!!!

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: But this isn't the time to celebrate yet... To be honest, it makes me rather nervous to work on such an important series when I don't even have anything else published yet...

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: I'll keep improving my skills while I try my best to complete this work.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: For this trip to Natlan, I'm not only planning to meet up with Varesa, Xilonen, and Nepecha, but I also want to explore as much of the local culture as I can, so I'll have plenty of reference for the job!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Heh heh. I got my hands on several... relics (?) from the Saurian Relics Association when I was selling fruits over at the Stadium of the Sacred Flame recently.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: So, in short, I now have a better understanding of how Fietena and Taika were portrayed in history, and even their Saurian companions and caravans!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: You can send me your first draft. I'd be happy to give you some feedback!

choices.text: Congrats!
That's good news.
Isn't your family worried about you?
Who's this? I don't think we've met before...?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Allow me to introduce Minnie, our lead artist at The Legion of Soulblazers. She's a friend of mine who's also really into woven scroll comics.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: We took part in the Dragonspine International Cross Country Challenge together, and placed pretty well in the end!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: This time, she's here to take in the culture of Natlan in preparation for a comic job!

choices.text: Have fun, you two.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Alright... we won't keep you any longer.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: #Do come by the Collective of Plenty when you have the time, {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Vanana and I will have the sweetest fruits ready for you!

choices.text: Please excuse me. I have to go take care of something.
(I don't really want to eat this though... Better bounce while I can.)

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Did you have a good time with Minnie? Is it about time to head back?

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: Yes, yes! We had so much fun!

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: Also, I took a closer look at the drawings Minnie gave me...

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: And in quite a few of them I saw... the idol of Mondstadt? Miss Barbara of the Church of Favonius is a really good dancer!

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: Didn't Mualani say she wanted another dance party at the resort? She even said that she wanted to invite dance experts from other nations this time...

dialogues.speaker: Nepecha
dialogues.text: Maybe Mualani would be interested in inviting Miss Barbara?

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Sounds like an idea. I'll show these drawings to Mualani and see what she says...

dialogues.speaker: Bennett
dialogues.text: #You know what, {NICKNAME}? It feels like we're becoming more and more in sync!

choices.text: I'd like to have a recap of what we went about collecting the paint.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Oh? Are you getting inspired too? Go for it then!

choices.text: What do you plan to do next?

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Hmm... I might be a bit short on time.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Since there are still a few days before the next caravan departs for Mondstadt, I want to try climbing the Great Volcano of Tollan.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Ahem, what I mean is I'd like to find a scenic spot on the outskirts to take in the view, while being mindful of local customs, of course.

choices.text: Make sure you stay safe.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Yes, I will! When I'm in Natlan, I feel unstoppable!

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: I hope everything goes smoothly for you too!

choices.text: Enjoy the scenery all you want but be sure to avoid any dangers.
See you next time, Bennett.

response.speaker: Bennett
response.text: Alright! Here's to swimming in luck and having the best stories to share when we meet next!

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: I met a few low-key fans of woven scroll comics while at the Easybreeze Holiday Resort recently. They were all discussing this new release...

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: ...Called "A Super Strong, But Also Overly Chill Tumaini."

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Huh. I think I've heard of it before...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: It's a crossover work by Ms. Vigee, an Interactive Film specialist, a light novel based on folk legends from Natlan in recent years.

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: Yes, that's right! But it's written in a way that's different from most mainstream works. It's almost like... a collection of travel anecdotes? And somehow, out of nowhere, it became this huge hit...

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: I think that when I finally become a real artist, I'll need to explore new concepts in my work too...

dialogues.speaker: Minnie
dialogues.text: And once I've honed my skills to a certain level, I'll try weaving in some comic-style storyboard panels into this work too!
